Title: Q: Kiss of Lachesis + equipment cost reduction

Messages.Author: Petri Wessman
Messages.Body:
Two related questions: first off, can I use Powerbase Tswane or
Eccentric Billionaire to reduce the cost of equipment I retrieve from
my own ash heap via Kiss of Lachesis? Both say that they reduce the
cost of a card I play by one, so does Kiss of Lachesis count for that?

If yes to above, how does the reduction work? Is the original cost
reduced (and then halved by Lachesis) or is the halved cost reduced by
one?

//Petri

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Petri Wessman wrote:
> Two related questions: first off, can I use Powerbase Tswane or
> Eccentric Billionaire to reduce the cost of equipment I retrieve from
> my own ash heap via Kiss of Lachesis? Both say that they reduce the
> cost of a card I play by one, so does Kiss of Lachesis count for that?

Kiss counts that, yeah.

> If yes to above, how does the reduction work? Is the original cost
> reduced (and then halved by Lachesis) or is the halved cost reduced by
> one?

RTR 7/7/7:
All cost-affecting cards operate no matter how the card is played ("as normal"
or otherwise). All multiplication and division is handled first, followed by
addition and subtraction.

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On Sun, 6 Jul 2008 04:18:32 -0700 (PDT), Petri Wessman wrote:

>Two related questions: first off, can I use Powerbase Tswane or
>Eccentric Billionaire to reduce the cost of equipment I retrieve from
>my own ash heap via Kiss of Lachesis?

No.

>Both say that they reduce the
>cost of a card I play by one, so does Kiss of Lachesis count for that?

Kiss of Lachesis is the only card you are playing. Its blood cost can
be reduced, but not by either of those cards.

You aren't "playing" the equipment, you are moving it.
